data.rationale: The proposal follows the same overall procedure (Booking search, then Xe EUR conversion, then a mail draft with the same subject and body), but it misses the "first hotel with score ≥8" rule, replaces the traveler parameter with a recipient and an undefined {name}, and says to Send when the true workflow says never send and Discard, so a build from this spec would be partly wrong and risky.
